plan_type.rationale: Plan type is a descriptive category, not a performance objective.

scheme_vintage_years.rationale: Age alone is not an investment quality signal.

aum_cr.rationale: Fund size has no universally better direction.

ter_pct.rationale: Lower verified recurring cost leaves more return with investors.

cagr_1y.rationale: Higher observed one-year annualized return is preferable for this comparison.

cagr_3y.rationale: Higher observed three-year annualized return is preferable for this comparison.

cagr_5y.rationale: Higher observed five-year annualized return is preferable for this comparison.

cagr_10y.rationale: Higher observed ten-year annualized return is preferable for this comparison.

rolling_3y_consistency.rationale: A larger share of positive rolling three-year windows indicates more consistent outcomes.

rolling_5y_consistency.rationale: A larger share of positive rolling five-year windows indicates more consistent outcomes.

benchmark_outperformance_ratio.rationale: More verified benchmark outperformance is preferable.

std_dev.rationale: Lower annualized return volatility is preferable when comparing risk.

max_drawdown.rationale: Drawdown is stored as a negative return, so closer to zero is better.

var_95.rationale: VaR is stored as a non-negative loss magnitude, so smaller loss is better.

tail_risk_ratio.rationale: A larger ratio of favorable tail gains to tail losses is preferable.

gain_loss_ratio.rationale: A larger average-gain to average-loss ratio is preferable.

sharpe.rationale: Higher excess return per unit of total volatility is preferable.

sortino.rationale: Higher excess return per unit of downside volatility is preferable.

omega.rationale: A larger probability-weighted gain-to-loss ratio is preferable.

calmar.rationale: Higher annualized return per unit of drawdown is preferable.

beta.rationale: Beta measures market sensitivity; the preferred exposure depends on the investor.

r_squared.rationale: R-squared measures fit to a benchmark, not fund quality by itself.

treynor.rationale: Higher excess return per unit of systematic risk is preferable.

jensen_alpha.rationale: Higher annualized risk-adjusted excess return is preferable.

information_ratio.rationale: Higher active return per unit of tracking risk is preferable.

upside_capture.rationale: Higher participation in benchmark up markets is preferable.

downside_capture.rationale: Lower participation in benchmark losses is preferable.

tracking_error.rationale: Lower active risk is preferable for passive benchmark comparison.

return_vs_subcategory_1y.rationale: Higher return relative to the local one-year peer median is preferable.

return_vs_subcategory_3y.rationale: Higher return relative to the local three-year peer median is preferable.

return_vs_subcategory_5y.rationale: Higher return relative to the local five-year peer median is preferable.

return_vs_subcategory_10y.rationale: Higher return relative to the local ten-year peer median is preferable.

absolute_return_3m.rationale: Higher observed three-month absolute return is preferable for this comparison.

absolute_return_6m.rationale: Higher observed six-month absolute return is preferable for this comparison.

rolling_3y_average_return.rationale: Higher average annualized rolling three-year return is preferable.

category_ytm.rationale: Yield varies with credit and duration risk and is not comparable alone.

average_ytm.rationale: Portfolio yield varies with credit and duration risk and is not comparable alone.

average_maturity.rationale: Maturity is an exposure characteristic, not a universal objective.

pe_ratio.rationale: Portfolio valuation depends on sector and strategy and has no universal direction.

category_pe_ratio.rationale: Category valuation depends on strategy and market conditions.

category_std_dev.rationale: Lower peer-category volatility indicates a calmer category environment.

equity_holding_pct.rationale: Asset allocation is a mandate exposure, not a quality ranking.

debt_holding_pct.rationale: Asset allocation is a mandate exposure, not a quality ranking.

largecap_holding_pct.rationale: Market-cap allocation depends on the fund mandate.

midcap_holding_pct.rationale: Market-cap allocation depends on the fund mandate.

smallcap_holding_pct.rationale: Market-cap allocation depends on the fund mandate.

sovereign_debt_pct.rationale: Issuer allocation depends on the fund mandate and risk appetite.

corporate_debt_pct.rationale: Issuer allocation depends on the fund mandate and risk appetite.

cash_holding_pct.rationale: Cash may be strategic liquidity or temporary cash drag.

top_10_concentration_pct.rationale: Concentration is an exposure trade-off, not universally better or worse.
